q: 奶奶从小就___包饺子，包得又快又好。
zh: 奶奶从小就会包饺子，包得又快又好。
py: nǎi nǎi cóng xiǎo jiù huì bāo jiǎo zi bāo de yòu kuài yòu hǎo
en: Grandma has known how to make dumplings since she was little, and she makes them quickly and well.
why: 从小就 plus 'quick and good' describes a skill she learned, so 会. 可以 would only say that making dumplings is allowed or is one option.

q: 我爸爸没学过英语，所以不___说英语。
zh: 我爸爸没学过英语，所以不会说英语。
py: wǒ bà bà méi xué guò yīng yǔ suǒ yǐ bú huì shuō yīng yǔ
en: My dad never studied English, so he can't speak it.
why: 没学过 shows the reason is never having learned, so the negative is 不会. 不可以 would mean he is forbidden to speak English, which the reason does not support.

q: 我妈妈___做蛋糕，生日蛋糕都是她自己做的。
zh: 我妈妈会做蛋糕，生日蛋糕都是她自己做的。
py: wǒ mā mā huì zuò dàn gāo shēng rì dàn gāo dōu shì tā zì jǐ zuò de
en: My mum knows how to bake cakes; all the birthday cakes are ones she made herself.
why: Her cakes show a skill she has, so 会. 可以 would say baking is allowed or optional and gives no reason why she is the one who bakes.

q: 我女儿四岁了，还不___自己系鞋带。
zh: 我女儿四岁了，还不会自己系鞋带。
py: wǒ nǚ ér sì suì le hái bú huì zì jǐ jì xié dài
en: My daughter is four and doesn't know how to tie her own shoelaces yet.
why: 还不 plus a small child points to a skill not yet learned, so 不会. 不可以 would mean someone forbids her to tie them.

q: 外婆不___用智能手机，每次都要我帮她发信息。
zh: 外婆不会用智能手机，每次都要我帮她发信息。
py: wài pó bú huì yòng zhì néng shǒu jī měi cì dōu yào wǒ bāng tā fā xìn xī
en: Grandma doesn't know how to use a smartphone; she always needs me to send messages for her.
why: Needing help every time shows she never learned how, so 不会. 不可以 would mean she is not allowed to use it, which makes no sense here.

q: 妈妈说她小时候没人教她游泳，所以到现在还不___游。
zh: 妈妈说她小时候没人教她游泳，所以到现在还不会游。
py: mā mā shuō tā xiǎo shí hòu méi rén jiào tā yóu yǒng suǒ yǐ dào xiàn zài hái bú huì yóu
en: Mum says nobody taught her to swim as a child, so even now she can't swim.
why: 没人教 means she never learned, so 不会. 不可以游 would be a ban on swimming, not a missing skill.

q: 我爷爷小时候没上过学，不___写字，只好请邻居帮他写信。
zh: 我爷爷小时候没上过学，不会写字，只好请邻居帮他写信。
py: wǒ yé yé xiǎo shí hòu méi shàng guò xué bú huì xiě zì zhǐ hǎo qǐng lín jū bāng tā xiě xìn
en: My grandpa never went to school as a child, so he can't write and has to ask a neighbour to write letters for him.
why: 没上过学 explains a skill he never acquired, so 不会. 不可以写字 would say he is not allowed to write, which is not the point.

q: 我的朋友在国外长大，从来不___用筷子，所以我们请他吃饭的时候给他拿了刀叉。
zh: 我的朋友在国外长大，从来不会用筷子，所以我们请他吃饭的时候给他拿了刀叉。
py: wǒ de péng yǒu zài guó wài zhǎng dà cóng lái bú huì yòng kuài zi suǒ yǐ wǒ men qǐng tā chī fàn de shí hòu gěi tā ná le dāo chā
en: My friend grew up abroad and has never known how to use chopsticks, so when we had him over for dinner we gave him a knife and fork.
why: Growing up abroad explains a missing skill, so 不会. 不可以 would imply chopsticks are forbidden to him, and nobody would swap them for a knife and fork for that reason.

q: 你看，云越来越多，一会儿一定___下雨。
zh: 你看，云越来越多，一会儿一定会下雨。
py: nǐ kàn yún yuè lái yuè duō yī huì r yí dìng huì xià yǔ
en: Look, the clouds are gathering; it is sure to rain in a while.
why: A forecast from the clouds is a prediction, so 会. 能 and 可以 talk about ability or permission, and rain cannot be allowed or able.

q: 别担心，这只小狗不___咬你，它很乖。
zh: 别担心，这只小狗不会咬你，它很乖。
py: bié dān xīn zhè zhǐ xiǎo gǒu bú huì yǎo nǐ tā hěn guāi
en: Don't worry, this puppy won't bite you; it is very well behaved.
why: 'It is well behaved' supports a prediction that it won't bite, so 不会. 不可以 would be a rule laid on the dog, and 不能 would say it is unable to bite.

q: 你不吃早饭，上课的时候___很饿。
zh: 你不吃早饭，上课的时候会很饿。
py: nǐ bù chī zǎo fàn shàng kè de shí hòu huì hěn è
en: If you skip breakfast, you'll be very hungry in class.
why: A consequence of skipping breakfast is a prediction, so 会. Hunger is not an ability or a permission, so 能 and 可以 fail.

q: 你不穿外套就出门，肯定___感冒。
zh: 你不穿外套就出门，肯定会感冒。
py: nǐ bù chuān wài tào jiù chū mén kěn dìng huì gǎn mào
en: Going out without a coat, you're sure to catch a cold.
why: 肯定 plus a result is a prediction, so 会. 可以 would suggest catching a cold is an allowed option, and 能 would mean you are able to catch one.

q: 妈妈看到你的成绩，一定___生气。
zh: 妈妈看到你的成绩，一定不会生气。
py: mā mā kàn dào nǐ de chéng jì yí dìng bú huì shēng qì
en: Mum surely won't be angry when she sees your grades.
why: Whether someone will be angry is a prediction, so 不会. 不能 or 不可以 would turn it into a ban on getting angry.

q: 你把牛奶放在外面，晚上就___坏。
zh: 你把牛奶放在外面，晚上就会坏。
py: nǐ bǎ niú nǎi fàng zài wài miàn wǎn shàng jiù huì huài
en: If you leave the milk out, it will go bad by tonight.
why: What will happen to the milk is a prediction, so 会. Milk spoiling is neither a skill nor a permission, so 能 and 可以 do not fit.

q: 孩子长得这么快，这件衣服明年就___小了。
zh: 孩子长得这么快，这件衣服明年就会小了。
py: hái zi zhǎng de zhè me kuài zhè jiàn yī fú míng nián jiù huì xiǎo le
en: Kids grow so fast; this piece of clothing will be too small next year.
why: 明年就…了 predicts a future state, so 会. 能 and 可以 would need someone able or allowed to do something, but clothes just become small.

q: 要是价钱一直不降，来买东西的客人就___越来越少。
zh: 要是价钱一直不降，来买东西的客人就会越来越少。
py: yào shì jià qián yì zhí bù jiàng lái mǎi dōng xī de kè rén jiù huì yuè lái yuè shǎo
en: If the prices never come down, fewer and fewer customers will come to shop.
why: 要是 … 就 sets up a predicted consequence, so 会. 能 or 可以 would suggest the customers are able or allowed to decrease.

q: 商店八点就关门，你九点才去，肯定___白跑一趟。
zh: 商店八点就关门，你九点才去，肯定会白跑一趟。
py: shāng diàn bā diǎn jiù guān mén nǐ jiǔ diǎn cái qù kěn dìng huì bái pǎo yī tàng
en: The shop closes at eight; if you only go at nine, you'll surely have made the trip for nothing.
why: 肯定 plus a predicted result takes 会. 能 would mean you are able to waste the trip and 可以 would make it a permission; neither predicts what will happen.

q: 别担心，这家店的东西不___很贵的。
zh: 别担心，这家店的东西不会很贵的。
py: bié dān xīn zhè jiā diàn de dōng xī bú huì hěn guì de
en: Don't worry, the things in this shop won't be very expensive.
why: 别担心 and a closing 的 mark a reassuring prediction, so 不会. 不能 or 不可以 would be a rule, not comfort.

q: 你放心，奶奶一定___喜欢这件新衣服的。
zh: 你放心，奶奶一定会喜欢这件新衣服的。
py: nǐ fàng xīn nǎi nǎi yí dìng huì xǐ huān zhè jiàn xīn yī fú de
en: Don't worry, Grandma will definitely like this new outfit.
why: 一定 … 的 is the assurance pattern with 会. Liking something is not an ability or a permission, so 能 and 可以 do not work.

q: 放心吧，我不___忘记你的生日的。
zh: 放心吧，我不会忘记你的生日的。
py: fàng xīn ba wǒ bú huì wàng jì nǐ de shēng rì de
en: Rest assured, I won't forget your birthday.
why: 放心吧 plus a closing 的 is a promise with 不会. 不能 or 不可以 would mean I am not allowed or able to forget, which is not a promise.

q: 你放心，店里的人不___多收你的钱的。
zh: 你放心，店里的人不会多收你的钱的。
py: nǐ fàng xīn diàn lǐ de rén bú huì duō shōu nǐ de qián de
en: Don't worry, the shop staff won't overcharge you.
why: 'Don't worry' makes this an assurance about what will happen, so 不会 ... 的. 不能 would read as a rule against overcharging, which is not reassurance.

q: 你要是把新手机弄丢了，爸爸一定不___高兴的。
zh: 你要是把新手机弄丢了，爸爸一定不会高兴的。
py: nǐ yào shì bǎ xīn shǒu jī nòng diū le bà bà yí dìng bú huì gāo xìng de
en: If you lose your new phone, Dad will definitely be unhappy.
why: A predicted reaction with 一定 and a final 的 takes 会. 不能高兴 or 不可以高兴 would mean he is forbidden to be happy.

q: 买这么多没用的东西，妈妈回来看到，一定___骂你的。
zh: 买这么多没用的东西，妈妈回来看到，一定会骂你的。
py: mǎi zhè me duō méi yòng de dōng xī mā mā huí lái kàn dào yí dìng huì mà nǐ de
en: If Mum comes back and sees you bought so many useless things, she'll definitely scold you.
why: This warns of a likely reaction, so 会 ... 的. 可以骂你 would mean she may scold you, as a permission, and 能 would be about her ability.

q: 我的腿很疼，现在不___走路。
zh: 我的腿很疼，现在不能走路。
py: wǒ de tuǐ hěn téng xiàn zài bù néng zǒu lù
en: My leg hurts a lot; I can't walk right now.
why: The pain stops me now, so 不能. 不会走路 would mean I never learned to walk.

q: 现在是晚上十二点，商店都关门了，我们不___买东西了。
zh: 现在是晚上十二点，商店都关门了，我们不能买东西了。
py: xiàn zài shì wǎn shàng shí èr diǎn shāng diàn dōu guān mén le wǒ men bù néng mǎi dōng xī le
en: It's midnight and the shops are all closed, so we can't buy anything now.
why: Shops being closed is the circumstance that blocks buying, so 不能. 不会买东西 would say we don't know how to buy things.

q: 我手机没电了，___打电话了。
zh: 我手机没电了，不能打电话了。
py: wǒ shǒu jī méi diàn le bù néng dǎ diàn huà le
en: My phone is dead, so I can't make calls.
why: No battery is the circumstance, so 不能. 不会打电话 would mean I never learned how to make a call.

q: 我会开车，可是今天喝了酒，所以不___开。
zh: 我会开车，可是今天喝了酒，所以不能开。
py: wǒ huì kāi chē kě shì jīn tiān hē le jiǔ suǒ yǐ bù néng kāi
en: I can drive, but I've been drinking today, so I can't.
why: The first clause says I have the skill, so only the situation (drinking) blocks me: 不能. 不会 would contradict 我会开车.

q: 电脑坏了，我现在不___上网。
zh: 电脑坏了，我现在不能上网。
py: diàn nǎo huài le wǒ xiàn zài bù néng shàng wǎng
en: The computer is broken, so I can't get online right now.
why: A broken computer is a circumstance, so 不能. 不会上网 would say I never learned how to go online.

q: 我会做饭，可是今天煤气坏了，不___做饭。
zh: 我会做饭，可是今天煤气坏了，不能做饭。
py: wǒ huì zuò fàn kě shì jīn tiān méi qì huài le bù néng zuò fàn
en: I can cook, but the gas is broken today, so I can't cook.
why: 可是 contrasts the skill with the blocking situation, so 不能. 不会做饭 would contradict the first clause.

q: 我的钱包不见了，我现在不___买东西。
zh: 我的钱包不见了，我现在不能买东西。
py: wǒ de qián bāo bú jiàn le wǒ xiàn zài bù néng mǎi dōng xī
en: My wallet is missing, so I can't buy anything right now.
why: With the wallet gone, buying is blocked by the situation: 不能. 不会 would say I lack the skill of shopping.

q: 爷爷的腿好了，已经___自己上楼了。
zh: 爷爷的腿好了，已经能自己上楼了。
py: yé yé de tuǐ hǎo le yǐ jīng néng zì jǐ shàng lóu le
en: Grandpa's leg has healed, and he can go upstairs by himself again.
why: An ability regained after getting better is 能. 会 would mean he has just learned to climb stairs, as a toddler would.

q: 我们昨天买的电视机坏了，所以今天不___看电视了，只好看手机。
zh: 我们昨天买的电视机坏了，所以今天不能看电视了，只好看手机。
py: wǒ men zuó tiān mǎi de diàn shì jī huài le suǒ yǐ jīn tiān bù néng kàn diàn shì le zhǐ hǎo kàn shǒu jī
en: The TV we bought yesterday broke, so we can't watch TV today and have to watch on our phones.
why: The broken set blocks watching, so 不能. 不会看电视 would mean we never learned to watch TV.

q: 客厅的灯坏了，孩子晚上想在客厅写作业也不___，只能去爸爸的房间写。
zh: 客厅的灯坏了，孩子晚上想在客厅写作业也不能，只能去爸爸的房间写。
py: kè tīng de dēng huài le hái zi wǎn shàng xiǎng zài kè tīng xiě zuò yè yě bù néng zhǐ néng qù bà bà de fáng jiān xiě
en: The living-room light is broken, so even if the child wants to do homework there in the evening, he can't and has to use Dad's room.
why: 想 ... 也不 says the wish is blocked by the broken light, a circumstance, so 不能. 不会 would say he never learned how to do homework there.

q: 我爸爸一顿___吃三碗米饭。
zh: 我爸爸一顿能吃三碗米饭。
py: wǒ bà bà yī dùn néng chī sān wǎn mǐ fàn
en: My dad can eat three bowls of rice in one meal.
why: The amount 三碗 measures his capacity, so 能. 会 would read as a prediction that he will eat three bowls.

q: 这个箱子很大，___放二十本书。
zh: 这个箱子很大，能放二十本书。
py: zhè ge xiāng zi hěn dà néng fàng èr shí běn shū
en: This box is big; it can hold twenty books.
why: A capacity with a number (二十本) is 能. 会放 would be a prediction about what someone will put in.

q: 这辆小汽车只___坐四个人，我们六个人坐不下。
zh: 这辆小汽车只能坐四个人，我们六个人坐不下。
py: zhè liàng xiǎo qì chē zhǐ néng zuò sì gè rén wǒ men liù gè rén zuò bù xià
en: This little car can only seat four people; the six of us don't fit.
why: 只能 plus a number gives the maximum capacity. 只会坐 would be a prediction and 只要坐 would mean 'only need to seat'.

q: 她一分钟___打一百个字，比我快多了。
zh: 她一分钟能打一百个字，比我快多了。
py: tā yì fēn zhōng néng dǎ yì bǎi gè zì bǐ wǒ kuài duō le
en: She can type a hundred characters a minute, much faster than me.
why: 一分钟 plus a count is a measured ability, so 能. 会 would only say she has learned to type, with no speed.

q: 我家的小狗很大，一次___吃两斤肉。
zh: 我家的小狗很大，一次能吃两斤肉。
py: wǒ jiā de xiǎo gǒu hěn dà yī cì néng chī liǎng jīn ròu
en: Our dog is big; it can eat a kilo of meat at a time.
why: A weight measured after the verb marks capacity, so 能. 会 would announce a future event instead.

q: 这家面包店的烤炉特别大，一次___烤三百个面包，所以不用等很久。
zh: 这家面包店的烤炉特别大，一次能烤三百个面包，所以不用等很久。
py: zhè jiā miàn bāo diàn de kǎo lú tè bié dà yī cì néng kǎo sān bǎi gè miàn bāo suǒ yǐ bú yòng děng hěn jiǔ
en: This bakery's oven is very big; it can bake three hundred loaves at a time, so there is no long wait.
why: 一次 plus 三百个 measures what the oven can handle, so 能. 会烤 would predict that someone will bake that many, not state capacity.

q: 奶奶年纪这么大了，一口气还___走五公里，身体真好。
zh: 奶奶年纪这么大了，一口气还能走五公里，身体真好。
py: nǎi nǎi nián jì zhè me dà le yī kǒu qì hái néng zǒu wǔ gōng lǐ shēn tǐ zhēn hǎo
en: Grandma is so old, yet she can still walk five kilometres in one go; her health is wonderful.
why: 一口气 plus 五公里 measures the stretch she can manage without stopping, so 能. 会 would not say she is able to manage that distance.

q: 这个冰箱不太大，一次最多___放二十瓶牛奶，再多就放不下了。
zh: 这个冰箱不太大，一次最多能放二十瓶牛奶，再多就放不下了。
py: zhè ge bīng xiāng bù tài dà yī cì zuì duō néng fàng èr shí píng niú nǎi zài duō jiù fàng bù xià le
en: This fridge isn't very big; it can hold at most twenty bottles of milk at a time, and more won't fit.
why: 最多 plus a number is the upper limit of capacity, so 能. 会放 would predict rather than measure.

q: 老师，我___用一下你的笔吗？
zh: 老师，我可以用一下你的笔吗？
py: lǎo shī wǒ kě yǐ yòng yī xià nǐ de bǐ ma
en: Teacher, may I use your pen for a moment?
why: Asking permission takes 可以. 会 would ask whether I will use it or know how to use a pen.

q: 妈妈，我___吃一个冰淇淋吗？
zh: 妈妈，我可以吃一个冰淇淋吗？
py: mā mā wǒ kě yǐ chī yí gè bīng qí lín ma
en: Mum, may I have an ice cream?
why: 'May I' is permission, so 可以. 会吃 would ask whether I will eat one, which is not a request.

q: 这家商店里___拍照，你拍吧。
zh: 这家商店里可以拍照，你拍吧。
py: zhè jiā shāng diàn lǐ kě yǐ pāi zhào nǐ pāi ba
en: Photos are allowed in this shop, go ahead and take one.
why: 你拍吧 shows the speaker is giving the go-ahead, so 可以. 会拍照 would predict that someone takes photos.

q: 这家商店的衣服___试穿，不满意也可以不买。
zh: 这家商店的衣服可以试穿，不满意也可以不买。
py: zhè jiā shāng diàn de yī fú kě yǐ shì chuān bù mǎn yì yě kě yǐ bù mǎi
en: You can try the clothes on in this shop, and you needn't buy if you're not happy.
why: Trying on is allowed, a shop policy, so 可以. 会试穿 would predict that someone will try them on.

q: 要是你觉得太贵，你___去旁边那家看看。
zh: 要是你觉得太贵，你可以去旁边那家看看。
py: yào shì nǐ jué de tài guì nǐ kě yǐ qù páng biān nà jiā kàn kàn
en: If you think it's too expensive, you could go and have a look at the shop next door.
why: This offers an option, a 'you could', so 可以. 会去 would be a flat claim that you will go.

q: 这个周末你要是没事，___来我家吃饭。
zh: 这个周末你要是没事，可以来我家吃饭。
py: zhè ge zhōu mò nǐ yào shì méi shì kě yǐ lái wǒ jiā chī fàn
en: If you're free this weekend, you can come to my place for dinner.
why: An invitation presents an open option, so 可以. 会来我家吃饭 would be a prediction, not an invitation.

q: 如果你觉得网上买东西不放心，也___先去商店看看，再决定买不买。
zh: 如果你觉得网上买东西不放心，也可以先去商店看看，再决定买不买。
py: rú guǒ nǐ jué de wǎng shàng mǎi dōng xī bù fàng xīn yě kě yǐ xiān qù shāng diàn kàn kàn zài jué dìng mǎi bù mǎi
en: If you don't feel safe buying online, you could also go and look in a shop first and then decide.
why: The suggestion offers an alternative, so 可以. 会先去商店看看 would claim you will definitely do so.

q: 买东西的时候，如果觉得价钱太贵，你___和老板商量一下，说不定能便宜一点儿。
zh: 买东西的时候，如果觉得价钱太贵，你可以和老板商量一下，说不定能便宜一点儿。
py: mǎi dōng xī de shí hòu rú guǒ jué de jià qián tài guì nǐ kě yǐ hé lǎo bǎn shāng liáng yī xià shuō bù dìng néng pián yi yì diǎn r
en: When shopping, if the price seems too high, you can talk it over with the owner; it might get cheaper.
why: Suggesting a feasible move is 可以. 会和老板商量 would state a prediction, and the later 能 belongs to the possible outcome, not this modal.

q: 妈妈，我可以买这个玩具吗？——___，你已经有很多玩具了。
zh: 妈妈，我可以买这个玩具吗？——不行，你已经有很多玩具了。
py: mā mā wǒ kě yǐ mǎi zhè ge wán jù ma bù xíng nǐ yǐ jīng yǒu hěn duō wán jù le
en: Mum, may I buy this toy? -- No, you already have lots of toys.
why: The reply to a 可以...吗 request is 不行 (or 不能). 不会 is for a missing skill or a prediction and cannot refuse a request.

q: 我明天要去医院，所以___来上课。
zh: 我明天要去医院，所以不能来上课。
py: wǒ míng tiān yào qù yī yuàn suǒ yǐ bù néng lái shàng kè
en: I have to go to the hospital tomorrow, so I can't come to class.
why: 'Can't make it' is 不能. 不可以 would mean someone forbids me to come.

q: 我的钱不够，今天___买这个包了。
zh: 我的钱不够，今天不能买这个包了。
py: wǒ de qián bù gòu jīn tiān bù néng mǎi zhè ge bāo le
en: I don't have enough money, so I can't buy this bag today.
why: Not enough money is a practical block, so 不能. 不可以 would mean the purchase is prohibited.

q: 医院里面___大声说话，别人在休息。
zh: 医院里面不可以大声说话，别人在休息。
py: yī yuàn lǐ miàn bù kě yǐ dà shēng shuō huà bié rén zài xiū xī
en: You may not talk loudly inside the hospital; others are resting.
why: A rule for others' sake is a prohibition, so 不可以. 不会 would predict that people don't talk loudly, which is not a rule.

q: 我问姐姐可不可以用她的电脑，姐姐说：“对不起，现在___，我要写作业。”
zh: 我问姐姐可不可以用她的电脑，姐姐说：“对不起，现在不行，我要写作业。”
py: wǒ wèn jiě jiě kě bù kě yǐ yòng tā de diàn nǎo jiě jiě shuō duì bù qǐ xiàn zài bù xíng wǒ yào xiě zuò yè
en: I asked my sister if I could use her computer, and she said, "Sorry, not right now; I need to do my homework."
why: The polite refusal to a 可以 request is 不行. 不会 cannot refuse permission, and 不用 would mean 'no need'.

q: 没学过英语的人，当然___说英语。
zh: 没学过英语的人，当然不会说英语。
py: méi xué guò yīng yǔ de rén dāng rán bú huì shuō yīng yǔ
en: Of course someone who has never studied English can't speak it.
why: 没学过 shows a missing skill, so 不会. 不可以 would say speaking English is banned for them.

q: 你放心，这家店的老板人很好，___骗你的。
zh: 你放心，这家店的老板人很好，不会骗你的。
py: nǐ fàng xīn zhè jiā diàn de lǎo bǎn rén hěn hǎo bù huì piàn nǐ de
en: Don't worry, the owner of this shop is a good man; he won't cheat you.
why: A prediction about his behaviour is 不会 ... 的. 不可以骗你 would be a rule imposed on him rather than a statement about his character.

q: 妈妈说，吃饭的时候___看手机，要专心吃饭。
zh: 妈妈说，吃饭的时候不可以看手机，要专心吃饭。
py: mā mā shuō chī fàn de shí hòu bù kě yǐ kàn shǒu jī yào zhuān xīn chī fàn
en: Mum says you may not look at your phone while eating; you have to focus on the meal.
why: A family rule is 不可以. 不会看手机 would say it just doesn't happen, which does not fit 要专心.

q: 我问老板可不可以多拿一份，他说___，每个人只能拿一份。
zh: 我问老板可不可以多拿一份，他说不行，每个人只能拿一份。
py: wǒ wèn lǎo bǎn kě bù kě yǐ duō ná yī fèn tā shuō bù xíng měi gè rén zhǐ néng ná yī fèn
en: I asked the boss if I could take an extra portion, and he said no; everyone can only take one.
why: Answering a 可不可以 question with a refusal is 不行. 不会 cannot refuse a request.

q: 我妈妈很___做饭，大家都爱吃她做的菜。
zh: 我妈妈很会做饭，大家都爱吃她做的菜。
py: wǒ mā mā hěn huì zuò fàn dà jiā dōu ài chī tā zuò de cài
en: My mum is really good at cooking; everyone loves her food.
why: Everyone loving her dishes shows skill, so 很会. 很能做饭 would suggest she cooks huge amounts, and 很可以 is never used.

q: 我弟弟很___吃，一个人吃了一只鸡。
zh: 我弟弟很能吃，一个人吃了一只鸡。
py: wǒ dì di hěn néng chī yí gè rén chī le yī zhī jī
en: My little brother can really eat; he ate a whole chicken by himself.
why: 一只鸡 is about quantity, so 很能吃. 很会吃 would mean he knows good food, and 很可以 does not work.

q: 她很___买东西，同样的东西总是买得比别人便宜。
zh: 她很会买东西，同样的东西总是买得比别人便宜。
py: tā hěn huì mǎi dōng xī tóng yàng de dōng xī zǒng shì mǎi de bǐ bié rén pián yi
en: She is very good at shopping; she always gets the same things cheaper than others.
why: Always buying cheaper shows skill, so 很会. 很能买东西 would hint at buying enormous amounts, and 可以 does not take 很.

q: 这只小狗真___吃，一下子吃了两斤肉。
zh: 这只小狗真能吃，一下子吃了两斤肉。
py: zhè zhǐ xiǎo gǒu zhēn néng chī yī xià zi chī le liǎng jīn ròu
en: This puppy can really eat; it ate a kilo of meat in one go.
why: The point is the amount eaten, so 真能吃. 真会吃 would praise how it chooses food and does not fit the quantity.

q: 老板很___说话，我本来只想看看，最后还是买了两件。
zh: 老板很会说话，我本来只想看看，最后还是买了两件。
py: lǎo bǎn hěn huì shuō huà wǒ běn lái zhǐ xiǎng kàn kàn zuì hòu hái shì mǎi le liǎng jiàn
en: The owner is very good with words; I only meant to look but ended up buying two items.
why: Talking me into buying shows persuasive skill, so 很会说话. 很能说话 would not mean this, and 很可以 is not a pattern.

q: 他太太很___做生意，同样的东西，她总能卖得比别人贵。
zh: 他太太很会做生意，同样的东西，她总能卖得比别人贵。
py: tā tài tài hěn huì zuò shēng yì tóng yàng de dōng xī tā zǒng néng mài de bǐ bié rén guì
en: His wife is very good at business; she can always sell the same goods for more than others.
why: Selling at higher prices shows business skill, so 很会做生意. 可以 cannot follow 很, and 很能 stresses quantity, not skill.

q: 你这个孩子真___说，一个人说了一个小时还没停。
zh: 你这个孩子真能说，一个人说了一个小时还没停。
py: nǐ zhè ge hái zi zhēn néng shuō yí gè rén shuō le yí gè xiǎo shí hái méi tíng
en: You really can talk, child; you've talked for a whole hour on your own and still haven't stopped.
why: Talking for an hour without stopping is about quantity and stamina, so 真能说. 真会说 would praise being clever with words, not how much you talk.

zh: 我明天不能去商店。
py: wǒ míng tiān bù néng qù shāng diàn
en: I can't go to the shop tomorrow.
why: 不能 sits before the verb 去 and means unable; 明天 may come before or after the subject, but 不可以 would mean forbidden.

zh: 姐姐一个小时能走五公里。
py: jiě jiě yí gè xiǎo shí néng zǒu wǔ gōng lǐ
en: My older sister can walk five kilometres in an hour.
why: The time span precedes 能 and the amount follows the verb. Putting the amount before the verb or using 会 would not express capacity.

zh: 你可以用我的手机。
py: nǐ kě yǐ yòng wǒ de shǒu jī
en: You may use my phone.
why: 可以 comes straight before the verb 用 to grant permission; 我的手机 stays together as the object.

zh: 明天会下大雨。
py: míng tiān huì xià dà yǔ
en: It will rain heavily tomorrow.
why: The time word opens the sentence, then 会 before the verb for the prediction; there is no subject for the weather.

zh: 他很会做生意。
py: tā hěn huì zuò shēng yì
en: He is very good at business.
why: 很会 is the skill pattern placed right before the verb phrase 做生意; 很 cannot be split from 会.

zh: 放心吧，我一定会来接你的。
py: fàng xīn ba wǒ yí dìng huì lái jiē nǐ de
en: Rest assured, I will definitely come and pick you up.
why: 一定 and 会 sit before the verb phrase and 的 closes the sentence; 的 directly after 会 is the classic error.

zh: 这儿不可以大声说话。
py: zhè r bù kě yǐ dà shēng shuō huà
en: You may not talk loudly here.
why: 不可以 comes before the verb phrase to state a ban, and 大声 stays in front of 说话. 这儿 as topic opens the rule.

zh: 因为感冒了，我不能去接孩子。
py: yīn wèi gǎn mào le wǒ bù néng qù jiē hái zi
en: Because I have a cold, I can't go and pick up the kid.
why: The reason clause may open the sentence or follow 我, but 不能 must stay directly before 去接孩子; 不会 would say I never learned to.

zh: 奶奶不会用手机。
py: nǎi nǎi bú huì yòng shǒu jī
en: Grandma doesn't know how to use a phone.
why: 不会 comes before the verb 用 and says the skill was never learned; 不可以 would be a ban.

zh: 这家店的老板很会和客人聊天。
py: zhè jiā diàn de lǎo bǎn hěn huì hé kè rén liáo tiān
en: The owner of this shop is very good at chatting with customers.
why: 很会 stays before the coverb phrase 和客人 and the verb 聊天; the whole skill phrase follows the subject 老板.

src_py: wǒ men zài zhè r pāi zhào
task: Ask politely if it is allowed (use 可以 and 吗).
zh: 我们可以在这儿拍照吗？
py: wǒ men kě yǐ zài zhè r pāi zhào ma
en: May we take photos here?
why: Permission question: 可以 goes before the verb phrase and 吗 closes the question. 会 would ask whether we will take photos, not whether it is allowed.

src_py: dì di chī le sì wǎn fàn
task: Say he can eat four bowls of rice in one meal (use 能).
zh: 弟弟一顿能吃四碗饭。
py: dì di yī dùn néng chī sì wǎn fàn
en: My little brother can eat four bowls of rice in one meal.
why: Capacity measured by an amount takes 能, and 了 is dropped because this is not a finished event. 会 would only predict.

src_py: wǒ jīn tiān qù shàng bān
task: Say you can't, because you are ill (use 不能 and 生病了).
zh: 我生病了，今天不能去上班。
py: wǒ shēng bìng le jīn tiān bù néng qù shàng bān
en: I'm ill, so I can't go to work today.
why: Illness is a circumstance, so 不能 right before the verb phrase. 不会 would mean I never learned to go to work, and 不可以 would mean I am forbidden.

task: Say he is really good at it (add 很).
zh: 他很会做饭。
py: tā hěn huì zuò fàn
en: He is really good at cooking.
why: 很 attaches directly to 会 to express skilfulness; the verb phrase follows. 很可以 would not work.

src_py: nǐ bù qù tā hěn nán guò
task: Make it a prediction with 如果 and 会.
zh: 如果你不去，她会很难过。
py: rú guǒ nǐ bù qù tā huì hěn nán guò
en: If you don't go, she will be very upset.
why: 如果 sets up the condition and 会 marks the prediction of her reaction; without 会 it would just state a fact.

s: 我女儿没会做饭。
s_py: wǒ nǚ ér méi huì zuò fàn
zh: 我女儿不会做饭。
py: wǒ nǚ ér bú huì zuò fàn
en: My daughter doesn't know how to cook.
why: The skill modal 会 is negated with 不, never 没; 没会 is not Chinese.

s: 明天可以下大雨，你带伞吧。
s_py: míng tiān kě yǐ xià dà yǔ nǐ dài sǎn ba
zh: 明天会下大雨，你带伞吧。
py: míng tiān huì xià dà yǔ nǐ dài sǎn ba
en: It will rain heavily tomorrow, so take an umbrella.
why: A weather forecast is a prediction, so 会. 可以 is permission or an option and cannot predict rain.

s: 你不穿外套，一会儿就会冷。
zh: 你不穿外套，一会儿就会冷。
py: nǐ bù chuān wài tào yī huì r jiù huì lěng
en: If you don't wear a coat, you'll soon be cold.
why: 会 is right: this predicts a result, and 会 can sit before an adjective like 冷. It does not need a verb.

s: 放心，爸爸会的来接你。
s_py: fàng xīn bà bà huì de lái jiē nǐ
zh: 放心，爸爸会来接你的。
py: fàng xīn bà bà huì lái jiē nǐ de
en: Rest assured, Dad will come and pick you up.
why: In the assurance pattern 的 must close the sentence; placing it right after 会 breaks the pattern.

s: 你放心，我一定会把钱还给你的。
zh: 你放心，我一定会把钱还给你的。
py: nǐ fàng xīn wǒ yí dìng huì bǎ qián huán gěi nǐ de
en: Don't worry, I will definitely pay you the money back.
why: This looks tricky because of 把, but 会 ... 的 wraps the whole 把 clause correctly and 的 stays at the end.

s: 我明天要上班，不能会去你家玩。
s_py: wǒ míng tiān yào shàng bān bù néng huì qù nǐ jiā wán
zh: 我明天要上班，不能去你家玩。
py: wǒ míng tiān yào shàng bān bù néng qù nǐ jiā wán
en: I have to work tomorrow, so I can't come to your place.
why: Two modals cannot be stacked; the work schedule is the circumstance, so 不能 alone.

s: 我会游泳，可是今天太冷，不能下水。
zh: 我会游泳，可是今天太冷，不能下水。
py: wǒ huì yóu yǒng kě shì jīn tiān tài lěng bù néng xià shuǐ
en: I can swim, but it's too cold today, so I can't get in.
why: Correct: 会 states the skill and 不能 states the circumstance that blocks it. Using 不会 in the second clause would contradict the first.

s: 我能会游一千米。
s_py: wǒ néng huì yóu yī qiān mǐ
zh: 我能游一千米。
py: wǒ néng yóu yī qiān mǐ
en: I can swim a thousand metres.
why: Two modals cannot be stacked here; the amount 一千米 already selects 能 alone.

s: 我女儿才三岁，一口气能数到一百。
zh: 我女儿才三岁，一口气能数到一百。
py: wǒ nǚ ér cái sān suì yì kǒu qì néng shù dào yì bǎi
en: My daughter is only three, yet she can count to a hundred in one breath.
why: 能 is correct because the amount reached (到一百) measures her capacity, and 才三岁 only adds surprise.

s: 妈妈，我会看一会儿电视吗？
s_py: mā mā wǒ huì kàn yī huì r diàn shì ma
zh: 妈妈，我可以看一会儿电视吗？
py: mā mā wǒ kě yǐ kàn yī huì r diàn shì ma
en: Mum, may I watch TV for a bit?
why: Asking permission needs 可以 (or 能). 会 would ask whether I will watch, not whether I am allowed.

s: 这儿不能拍照，但是你可以在外面拍。
zh: 这儿不能拍照，但是你可以在外面拍。
py: zhè r bù néng pāi zhào dàn shì nǐ kě yǐ zài wài miàn pāi
en: Photos aren't allowed here, but you can take them outside.
why: Correct: 不能 states the rule and 可以 offers the alternative. The two modals do not clash because they belong to different clauses.

s: 我可以坐这儿吗？不会，这儿有人。
s_py: wǒ kě yǐ zuò zhè r ma bú huì zhè r yǒu rén
zh: 我可以坐这儿吗？不行，这儿有人。
py: wǒ kě yǐ zuò zhè r ma bù xíng zhè r yǒu rén
en: May I sit here? No, someone is sitting here.
why: The refusal to a permission question is 不行 or 不能. 不会 is for missing skills or predictions and cannot answer 可以...吗.

s: 我不会开车，所以今天不能送你。
zh: 我不会开车，所以今天不能送你。
py: wǒ bú huì kāi chē suǒ yǐ jīn tiān bù néng sòng nǐ
en: I don't know how to drive, so I can't take you today.
why: Correct: 不会 gives the missing skill and 不能 gives the resulting impossibility; the two negatives belong together.

s: 我妈妈很可以做饭。
s_py: wǒ mā mā hěn kě yǐ zuò fàn
zh: 我妈妈很会做饭。
py: wǒ mā mā hěn huì zuò fàn
en: My mum is very good at cooking.
why: 'Good at' is 很会. 可以 is permission or an option and cannot take 很 in this meaning.

s: 我爸爸很能睡，一睡就是十个小时。
zh: 我爸爸很能睡，一睡就是十个小时。
py: wǒ bà bà hěn néng shuì yī shuì jiù shì shí gè xiǎo shí
en: My dad can really sleep; once he's asleep it's ten hours.
why: Correct: 很能 + verb means a large capacity, and the ten hours confirm it. 很会睡 would sound like skill at sleeping.

s: 别担心，明天不可以下雨。
s_py: bié dān xīn míng tiān bù kě yǐ xià yǔ
zh: 别担心，明天不会下雨。
py: bié dān xīn míng tiān bú huì xià yǔ
en: Don't worry, it won't rain tomorrow.
why: A forecast that it won't rain is 不会. 不可以 would mean rain is forbidden, which is not a weather statement.

s: 这个小孩太小了，不可以自己去商店买东西，让妈妈陪他。
zh: 这个小孩太小了，不可以自己去商店买东西，让妈妈陪他。
py: zhè ge xiǎo hái tài xiǎo le bù kě yǐ zì jǐ qù shāng diàn mǎi dōng xī ràng mā mā péi tā
en: This child is too small to go to the shop alone; let his mum go with him.
why: Correct: the rule against going alone is a prohibition, so 不可以 is right. It looks suspicious but is a permission issue.

s: 你放心，奶奶会的喜欢这个礼物。
s_py: nǐ fàng xīn nǎi nǎi huì de xǐ huān zhè ge lǐ wù
zh: 你放心，奶奶会喜欢这个礼物的。
py: nǐ fàng xīn nǎi nǎi huì xǐ huān zhè ge lǐ wù de
en: Don't worry, Grandma will like this gift.
why: The 的 of reassurance goes at the very end of the clause; inserting it right after 会 is a classic error.

s: 天气预报说，下午会有雨，你出门别忘了带伞。
zh: 天气预报说，下午会有雨，你出门别忘了带伞。
py: tiān qì yù bào shuō xià wǔ huì yǒu yǔ nǐ chū mén bié wàng le dài sǎn
en: The forecast says there will be rain this afternoon, so don't forget your umbrella when you go out.
why: Correct: 会有雨 predicts rain, and 会 is also fine before 有. 可以有雨 would be wrong.

s: 我们这个周末要带孩子去考试，不能去看奶奶。
zh: 我们这个周末要带孩子去考试，不能去看奶奶。
py: wǒ men zhè ge zhōu mò yào dài hái zi qù kǎo shì bù néng qù kàn nǎi nǎi
en: We have to take the child to an exam this weekend, so we can't visit Grandma.
why: Correct: the exam is a practical obstacle, so 不能 is exactly right. 不会 would turn it into a prediction.
